Опыт Farming и Garden, медали Jacob's Co: Farming and Garden XP, Jacob's Contest medals
Открой вкладку «Культуры» и выбери культ: Open the "Crops" tab and pick a crop: income there is recalculated for your Farming Fortune.
Поставь ферму под эту культуру на участк: Build a farm for this crop on a Garden plot so you walk in a straight line without turning the camera.
Возьми инструмент под культуру (Theoreti: Take the tool for the crop (Theoretical Hoe, Melon/Pumpkin Dicer, Cactus Knife, Coco Chopper, Fungi Cutter).
Фарми сессиями по 30–60 минут. Pests (pe: Farm in 30–60 minute sessions. Kill Pests with a vacuum: they drop expensive items.
Продавай в том виде, который советует са: Sell in the form the site recommends (NPC, raw or compressed on the Bazaar). Join Jacob's Contest when your crop is listed.
При большом объёме цена сжатых форм на B: At high volume, compressed form prices on the Bazaar sag: sell in parts.
С патча 0.27.3 NPC платит за культуры ме: Since patch 0.27.3 the NPC pays less for crops, so the NPC is now rarely the best option.
Макросы и автокликеры запрещены: за них: Macros and autoclickers are not allowed: they get you banned.
Открой вкладку «Флипы Bazaar» и отфильтр: Open the "Bazaar flips" tab and filter by price: keep no more than half your free coins in one flip.
Поставь ордер на покупку на 0,1 монеты в: Place a buy order 0.1 coin above the best one (exact price in the table).
Когда ордер исполнится, забери товар и с: When the order fills, collect the goods and immediately place a sell order 0.1 below the best offer.
Каждые несколько минут проверяй /bz: есл: Check /bz every few minutes: if you were outbid, cancel the order and place it again.
Держи 3–5 флипов на разных товарах, чтоб: Keep 3–5 flips on different items so you don't depend on one.
Пока товар у тебя, цену могут уронить: т: While you hold the item, the price can be dumped: then you sell at a loss or wait.
Товар с резко завышенной ценой обычно на: An item with a sharply inflated price is usually manipulated. The site hides those by default.
Монеты в ордерах заморожены до исполнени: Coins in orders are frozen until they fill, and the number of Bazaar orders is limited.
С каждой продажи Bazaar берёт налог 1,12: The Bazaar takes a 1.125–1.25% tax on each sale.
Во вкладке «Крафт и Forge» выбери рецепт: In the "Craft and Forge" tab pick a recipe with good profit and sales volume, without the 🔒 lock.
Купи ингредиенты: ордером на покупку деш: Buy the ingredients: a buy order is cheaper, instant is faster. The components and intermediate crafts are shown in the recipe row.
Скрафти предмет (/craft или Crafting Tab: Craft the item (/craft or a Crafting Table).
Продай ордером на Bazaar или выставь BIN: Sell with a Bazaar order or list a BIN on the auction house slightly below the cheapest lot.
Пока собираешь ингредиенты, цены меняютс: Prices change while you gather ingredients. Recheck before buying.
Аукцион продаёт медленнее и берёт комисс: The auction house sells slower and charges fees: 1–2.5% for listing and 1% when collecting coins.
Для предметов с аукциона берём цену по р: For auction items we use real sales over the day, without stars, enchants or reforge. Rare expensive items take days to sell: income accounts for demand.
Иди к Forge в Dwarven Mines (/warp forge: Go to the Forge in the Dwarven Mines (/warp forge).
Во вкладке «Крафт и Forge» включи «Тольк: In the "Craft and Forge" tab turn on "Forge only" and pick a recipe by income per slot and duration.
Купи ингредиенты на Bazaar и загрузи все: Buy the ingredients on the Bazaar and fill all slots.
Когда таймер закончится, забери и продай: When the timer ends, collect and sell. Refill the slots right away.
Монеты заморожены на время ковки: от час: Coins are frozen while forging: from an hour to several days.
Пока предмет куётся, его цена может упас: The price can drop while the item is forging.
Длинные рецепты выгодны, только если зах: Long recipes pay off only if you log in on time: an empty slot earns nothing.
Монеты на ингредиенты для всех слотов: Coins for ingredients for all slots
Дождись мэра Diana: ивент Mythological R: Wait for mayor Diana: the Mythological Ritual event only runs with her.
Возьми у Diana в Hub Ancestral Spade и G: Get an Ancestral Spade and a Griffin pet from Diana in the Hub (the higher the rarity, the better the drops).
Копай Griffin Burrows по подсказкам лопа: Dig Griffin Burrows following the spade's hints: burrows give treasure and mobs (up to the Minos Inquisitor).
Продавай Chimera, Minos Relic, Daedalus: Sell Chimera, Minos Relic, Daedalus Stick and Griffin Feathers.
Только при мэре Diana, раз в несколько д: Only with mayor Diana, once every few days.
Во время ивента дропов много, их цены па: During the event there are many drops and their prices fall.
Заходи в Garden: Visitors копятся сами (: Visit the Garden: Visitors pile up by themselves (up to 5 at once).
Открой заказ и сравни стоимость нужных т: Open an order and compare the cost of the requested goods on the Bazaar with the reward.
Принимай выгодные заказы и отклоняй убыт: Accept profitable orders and decline losing ones.
Copper трать в SkyMart (апгрейды Compost: Spend Copper at SkyMart (Composter upgrades, Pest items).
Часть заказов убыточна: проверяй цену ну: Some orders lose money: check the price of the request before accepting.
Редкие Visitors дают лучшие награды, но: Rare Visitors give better rewards, but appear rarely.
Подойди к Experimentation Table на своём: Go to the Experimentation Table on your island.
Раз в день пройди Superpairs (и Chronoma: Once a day do Superpairs (and Chronomatron/Ultrasequencer for extra clicks).
Продавай Titanic/Grand Experience Bottle: Sell Titanic/Grand Experience Bottles and books.
Takes memory and about 10 minutes a day.
